## Overall model sensitivity {#rd02-random-effects-review}

**Comparison record.** The comparison includes three joint structures—site by
species, full design nesting, and both together—fitted to all four species
(256 rows) and to RW/TO only (128 rows). Separate RW and TO fits use site and
macro-plot random intercepts, with the plot-level effect omitted. The selected
four-category separate models are included in the 256-row comparison. AIC ranks
models within each dataset; the separate pair combines both species'
likelihoods and parameter counts.

```{r}
#| label: rd02-comparison-values
#| include: false
rd02_cmp_dir <- "outputs/regeneration/overall-sensitivity"
rd02_cmp_fit <- read.csv(file.path(rd02_cmp_dir, "tables/rd02-overall-model-comparison.csv"))
rd02_cmp_means <- read.csv(file.path(rd02_cmp_dir, "tables/rd02-overall-integrated-estimates.csv"))
rd02_scope_label <- c(`Four-species fits` = "4 species (256)", `RW/TO fits` = "RW/TO (128)")
rd02_aic <- function(id) {
  value <- rd02_cmp_fit$AIC[rd02_cmp_fit$model_id == id]
  stopifnot(length(value) == 1L)
  sprintf("%.2f", value)
}
rd02_mean_ci <- function(id, species, treatment) {
  value <- subset(rd02_cmp_means, model_id == id & spp == species & treat == treatment)
  stopifnot(nrow(value) == 1L)
  sprintf("%.2f (%.2f, %.2f)", value$estimate, value$lcl, value$ucl)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: tbl-rd02-random-effects-fit
#| echo: false
#| tbl-cap: "Sensitivity-model fit. Delta AIC is calculated within each dataset. Separate-species rows combine independent category likelihoods and parameter counts: 32 parameters for four categories, 16 for RW/TO. The selected primary analysis is marked. All component fits converged with positive-definite Hessians."
rd02_fit_table <- data.frame(
  Data = unname(rd02_scope_label[rd02_cmp_fit$fit_scope]),
  Model = ifelse(rd02_cmp_fit$selected_primary,
                 paste0(rd02_cmp_fit$model_label, " (selected)"), rd02_cmp_fit$model_label),
  Parameters = rd02_cmp_fit$k,
  AIC = rd02_cmp_fit$AIC,
  `Delta AIC` = rd02_cmp_fit$delta_AIC_within_scope,
  check.names = FALSE
)
knitr::kable(rd02_fit_table, digits = 2, row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
#| label: fig-rd02-random-effects-comparison
#| echo: false
#| out-width: "100%"
#| fig-cap: >
#|   Overall basal-area sensitivity. Top panels show joint fits and the
#|   selected separate models for all four categories; bottom panels show
#|   RW/TO joint fits and separate species models with site
#|   and macro-plot random intercepts. Points are arithmetic means including
#|   modeled zeros and integrated over fitted random effects; ranges are
#|   approximate 95% confidence intervals from the full-covariance log-scale
#|   delta method. Vertical scales differ between panels.
knitr::include_graphics("assets/rd02-sensitivity/figures/rd02-overall-sensitivity.png")
```

Notable patterns across the comparisons:

- **Treatment patterns persist.** Redwood means follow GS > LD > HA > HD;
  tanoak means follow GS > LD > HD > HA. The redwood–tanoak ranking within HD
  changes under shared full nesting, so that species comparison is sensitive
  to model structure.
- **Separate species show different site variation.** Site SDs are about 0.72
  for RW and 0.16 for TO; macro-plot variances approach zero. RW has a wider GS
  interval, while TO intervals are narrower than in the lead draft. Removing
  the plot-level effect leaves means and intervals unchanged at two decimals
  and lowers the separate pair's AIC by 4.00 to
  `r rd02_aic("separate_site_macro_pair")`, slightly below joint full nesting
  (`r rd02_aic("joint_full_nested_rwto")`). Site-by-species remains lowest
  within both datasets.
- **Diagnostics are broadly consistent.** Uniformity, dispersion, and
  zero-frequency checks show no flags across models. Only the four-species
  thesis fit has an outlier flag: p = 0.015 with 1,000 simulations and about
  0.050 with 10,000, with different observations flagged. The RW/TO refits and
  separate models show no outlier flags. Alternative-optimizer checks agree.
